title: EvaluationRunnerInput
description: Input for the evaluation_runner tool. Accepts a batch of samples and runs local API evaluation plus Qwen output parsing.

samples.description: List of evaluation samples. Each sample has an image path and a set of prompts/references for scoring.

image_path.description: Absolute local path to the generated image to evaluate.

reference_image_path.description: Absolute local path to the reference image for comparison, or null.

qwen_output_path.description: Path to Qwen model raw JSON output for this sample, if already available.

budget_usd.description: Maximum OpenAI API budget in USD for this batch. Null means use config default.
